title: fix(review-agent): handle null content from the pre-review model
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix: app pre-review crashed with `expected string or bytes-like object, got 'NoneType'` when the reasoning model used its whole 500-token budget on reasoning and returned `content: null`
- Raises `max_tokens` to 2000 and treats null content as empty, so a failure gives a readable `finish_reason` error
- Same fix as #16160 by @mhmdrizzzki (credited as co-author), landed from an in-repo branch because the fork PR's required checks never ran

Fixes #16159

gist.headline: Room to think, room to review
gist.blurb: The app pre-review agent gets a larger thinking budget and a sensible response when the model returns nothing. Thanks to @mhmdrizzzki for the original fix.
gist.summary: App pre-review raises the reasoning model's max_tokens from 500 to 2000 and treats null content as empty, replacing a NoneType crash with a readable finish_reason error when the model still returns no answer.
gist.impact: App submissions are less likely to hit a pre-review crash when the model spends its token budget reasoning; if it returns no content, the error identifies why it stopped.
